name: Yoru ni Saku Hana
source:
Main character is rejected by Satoko without explaining the reason. In order to forget about the girl he sets off to an outlying prostitution island that is not listed in travel guides.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/12/vn-of-month-march-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角没有得到聪子的解释便被拒绝。为了忘记她，他前往一座旅游指南上不存在的偏远妓院岛。

[译自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/12/vn-of-month-march-2000.html]VNDB Review[/url]]
